# Data Dictionary

Field-level reference for the MNEMOS schema. Types are PostgreSQL types.
"Generated by" says who is allowed to set the value.

## Enumerations

### `source_kind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `document` | A file the user uploaded (PDF, Markdown, plain text). Requires `original_filename`. |
| `note` | Text the user typed into the app. Must not have a filename. |

### `processing_status`

Coarse position of a **source** in the ingestion pipeline.

| Value | Meaning | Next states |
|---|---|---|
| `pending` | Row created, original stored, nothing attempted | `validating`, `failed` |
| `validating` | Checking size, MIME, encoding, structure | `extracting`, `failed` |
| `extracting` | Parsing to text | `extracted`, `failed` |
| `extracted` | Text stored in `extracted_contents` | `chunking`, `failed` |
| `chunking` | Splitting into chunks | `indexing`, `failed` |
| `indexing` | Embedding chunks and writing the vector index | `ready`, `failed` |
| `ready` | Queryable: chunks exist and embeddings are present | — (terminal) |
| `failed` | Terminal error, see `processing_error_code` | `pending` on an explicit retry |

### `extraction_status`

Per **version**: `pending` → `extracting` → `extracted` | `failed`.

### `embedding_status`

Per **chunk**: `pending` → `embedded` | `failed`.

### `information_status`

Epistemic status of a **passage**, orthogonal to processing status.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `current` | Believed current. Default for newly ingested material. |
| `superseded` | A later revision replaced it as the current account. The row stays. |
| `disputed` | A credible conflicting passage exists; neither is treated as current truth. |
| `archived` | Kept for history but excluded from default retrieval. |
| `pending_review` | A correction was proposed and awaits user confirmation (4A). |

Transitions and their justification arrive in 4A. In 2A only `current` is set
by the ingestion path, and users cannot change the value directly (RLS grants
`SELECT` only).

## Tables

### `sources`

| Field | Type | Null | Set by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | DB | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `workspace_id` | uuid | no | service | Caller must hold `owner`/`editor`. |
| `owner_id` | uuid | no | service (from token) | Never from the request body. |
| `kind` | enum | no | service | |
| `title` | text | no | user | 1–300 chars, trimmed. |
| `original_filename` | text | depends | user | Normalized; NULL for notes. |
| `mime_type` | text | no | service | Validated against an allow-list. |
| `size_bytes` | bigint | no | service | Measured server-side. ≤ 50 MiB. |
| `content_hash` | text | no | service | sha256 of the stored bytes. |
| `storage_bucket` | text | no | service | Defaults to `sources`. |
| `storage_path` | text | no | service | `<user_id>/<uuid>.<ext>`; never client-supplied. |
| `processing_status` | enum | no | service | |
| `processing_error_code` | text | yes | service | Machine-readable, ≤ 64 chars. |
| `processing_error_detail` | text | yes | service | Human-readable, sanitized, ≤ 500 chars. |
| `processing_attempts` | integer | no | service | Incremented on each retry. |
| `idempotency_key` | text | yes | client | 8–128 chars; unique per workspace. |
| `metadata` | jsonb | no | service | Genuinely flexible extras only. |
| `submitted_at` | timestamptz | no | service | When the user submitted. |
| `created_at` / `updated_at` | timestamptz | no | DB | Trigger-maintained. |

### `document_versions`

| Field | Type | Null | Set by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | DB | |
| `workspace_id` | uuid | no | service | Must match the source. |
| `source_id` | uuid | no | service | |
| `version_number` | integer | no | trigger | 1, 2, 3 … per source. |
| `content_hash` | text | no | service | Immutable after insert. |
| `size_bytes` | bigint | no | service | Immutable. |
| `mime_type` | text | no | service | |
| `storage_bucket` / `storage_path` | text | no | service | Immutable. |
| `extraction_status` | enum | no | service | |
| `extraction_method` | text | yes | service | `plain-text`, `markdown`, `pdf`. |
| `extraction_error_code` | text | yes | service | |
| `extraction_error_detail` | text | yes | service | |
| `extracted_at` | timestamptz | yes | service | Set on success. |
| `indexing_config` | jsonb | no | service | Chunking + embedding configuration (2C). |
| `is_current` | boolean | no | service | Only `true → false` is permitted. |
| `idempotency_key` | text | yes | client | |
| `submitted_by` | uuid | yes | service | `SET NULL` on user deletion. |
| `submitted_at` | timestamptz | no | service | Copied into provenance. |
| `created_at` / `updated_at` | timestamptz | no | DB | |

### `extracted_contents`

| Field | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | |
| `workspace_id` | uuid | no | Must match the version. |
| `document_version_id` | uuid | no | UNIQUE — one extraction per version. |
| `content` | text | no | Plain text, normalized newlines. |
| `content_hash` | text | no | sha256 of `content`. |
| `char_count` | integer | no | Checked equal to `char_length(content)`. |
| `extraction_method` | text | no | Parser identity. |
| `page_count` | integer | no | 0 when the format has no pages. |
| `metadata` | jsonb | no | Encoding detected, parser warnings, truncation flags. |

### `extracted_pages`

| Field | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_version_id` | uuid | no | UNIQUE with `page_number`. |
| `page_number` | integer | no | 1-based. |
| `start_offset` / `end_offset` | integer | no | Half-open range into `extracted_contents.content`. |

### `chunks`

| Field | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | |
| `workspace_id` / `source_id` / `document_version_id` | uuid | no | All three must agree. |
| `chunk_index` | integer | no | 0-based, UNIQUE per version. |
| `content` | text | no | Non-empty. |
| `content_hash` | text | no | sha256 of `content`. |
| `char_count` | integer | no | `char_length(content)`, checked. |
| `source_location` | jsonb | no | `{start_offset, end_offset, page?}`. |
| `chunking_method` | text | no | e.g. `paragraph-window`. |
| `chunking_version` | integer | no | Bumped when the algorithm changes. |
| `embedding_status` | enum | no | |
| `metadata` | jsonb | no | Token estimate, overlap flags. |

### `provenance_records`

| Field | Type | Null | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | no | This is `provenance_id`. |
| `workspace_id` / `source_id` / `document_version_id` | uuid | no | Cross-checked against the chunk. |
| `chunk_id` | uuid | no | UNIQUE. |
| `source_location` | jsonb | no | Must equal the chunk's location. |
| `information_status` | enum | no | Default `current`. |
| `revision_of` / `superseded_by` | uuid | yes | Self-referencing; populated in 4A. |
| `resolution_metadata` | jsonb | no | How the location was resolved. |
| `submitted_at` | timestamptz | no | Must equal the version's `submitted_at`. |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no | |

## API representation

The API uses `snake_case` in JSON (matching Pydantic) and the frontend adapts
it in `src/lib/api`. It does **not** currently camel-case responses; that is a
deliberate, documented choice in ADR-0007 (one shape for both layers, so the
OpenAPI schema is the single contract).

## Identity rules

- All identifiers are UUIDs; none is sequential or guessable.
- `content_hash` is always lowercase sha256 hex, never a client-supplied value.
- A user id is only ever taken from a verified JWT (`Identity.user_id`).
